tariff_plan_bills

Source: R/finance.R
tariff_plan_bills.Rd

tariff_plan_bills

tariff_plan_bills(
  kWh,
  phi,
  gamma,
  eta,
  tau,
  natural_profile = "LP1",
  smart_rollout,
  prices_scen,
  params
)

Arguments

kWh

annual load

phi

\(\phi\)

gamma

\(\gamma\)

eta

\(\eta\)

tau

\(\tau\)

natural_profile

the characteristic profile of the household (currently LP1 or LP3)

smart_rollout

smart meter rollout time

prices_scen

price scenario

params

scenario parameters at params$yeartime

Value

dataframe

Examples

prices_scen <- set_prices(sD)
params <- scenario_params(sD,2034)
tariff_plan_bills(8760,phi=0.5,1,0.5,48,"LP1",2025,prices_scen,params)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   tariff_plan annual_bill
#>   <chr>             <dbl>
#> 1 tou               2988.
#> 2 dynamic           2996.
#> 3 flat              3446.
tariff_plan_bills(8760,phi=0.5,1,0.5,48,"LP1",2025,prices_scen,params)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   tariff_plan annual_bill
#>   <chr>             <dbl>
#> 1 tou               2988.
#> 2 dynamic           2996.
#> 3 flat              3446.
tariff_plan_bills(8760,phi=0.5,2,eta=0.5,48,"LP1",2025,prices_scen,params)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 2
#>   tariff_plan annual_bill
#>   <chr>             <dbl>
#> 1 tou               2994.
#> 2 dynamic           3006.
#> 3 flat              3446.
